title: European LNG assessment falls 5% in a day
summary: The EU-wide assessment reached €80.736/MWh, down from €85.002/MWh on 19 November. Northwest and southern Europe also recorded lower assessments.

title: Oil shipments through Middle East chokepoints rose 19% in Q3
summary: EIA found higher combined oil and product shipments than in the prior quarter. Hormuz and Suez volumes rose, while Bab el-Mandeb volumes fell.

title: US gas storage enters winter above its five-year average
summary: The Lower 48 finished October with 3,810 billion cubic feet of working gas, nearly 2% above average. Stocks were already elevated at the start of the injection season.

title: OpenAI reports chip-design results on Jalapeño and open processors
summary: OpenAI describes how engineers used models to improve compute blocks for its inference chip and tested successive models on two open-source processor designs.

title: Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon
summary: Google reports a score of 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its highest thinking setting. The launch targets complex coding and knowledge work.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to developers
summary: Both models accept text and images. OpenAI positions Astra for demanding reasoning and Sol for lower-cost multi-step tasks.

title: NVIDIA reports $107.6 billion in quarterly data centre revenue
summary: The segment grew 110% year over year in the quarter ending 25 October. NVIDIA also reported its first shipments of the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform.

title: IEA projects a 2026 oil demand decline and a rebound in 2027
summary: Its November outlook puts 2026 global demand at 102.3 million barrels a day and forecasts a two-million-barrel-a-day increase next year.

title: North Slope projects lift Alaska oil output forecast
summary: EIA expects production to reach 505,000 barrels per day in 2027, a 13% rise on the prior year if realised.
